title: Erosion dissolve: a patched standard material discarded below a scrolled noise threshold
intent: Dissolve the hero to change the subject
summary: One stock `MeshStandardMaterial` on a lathe-turned cone patched by `onBeforeCompile`: three octaves of hashed 3D value noise in object space (frequency `2.6`, amplitude `±.14`) added to a 0–1 height along a world-space axis, `discard` below a front that runs from under every field value at `uProgress 0` to over every value at `1`, a hashed feather of `.025`, an emissive ember band `uEdge .03` that never thins below 1.5 px (`max(fwidth(d), 1e-5)`) and charring over four band widths; one ScrollTrigger maps a `380svh` sticky stage to `uProgress` between `.12` and `.88` (ease none, Lenis on the GSAP ticker), the cone turns `.8 rad` and the renderer draws one frame per change, none while idle or off screen; reduced motion cuts each of three chapters to a still (`0 / .5 / 1`), and the static tier, `?nogl` or no WebGL2 show an SVG still whose wavy clip burns to the same level
variants: erosion from the tip down along world −y with an ember band (this)
a sideways exit: uAxis (1, 0, 0), the noise frequency halved, no ember (a cool edge colour instead)
a loaded glTF: the same patch on its stock material, uMin / uMax from its bounding box along the axis
R3F: onBeforeCompile on a memoised <meshStandardMaterial>, uniforms in a ref, frameloop="demand" and invalidate() from the trigger
